text: t3: compare count(ka) vs count(se): verified. Passed at full precision, and every effect exceeds its null distribution.

Circuit = heads 1.0, 1.1 + mlp0, mlp1, mlp2 (local-full, full precision). Joint mean-ablation of 1.0+1.1 -> 0.01 of clean (E0010); joint mean-ablation of the other ten heads -> 1.0 of clean (E0011); resample-ablating each MLP alone -> -0.01 of clean (E0012, E0013, E0014). Head 1.0 attends uniformly over BOS + 'se' positions (BOS weight 0.25 with 3 se, E0008; 0.5 with 1 se, E0006); head 1.1 uniformly over BOS + 'ka' positions (0.5 with 1 ka, E0009; 1/3 with 2 ka, E0007). After layer 0 information is spread over token positions (each 0.23-0.29), after layer 1 it sits entirely at position 5 (effect 1.0, E0017). Held-out verification V0001 (seed 7, n=400): predict() agreement 1.0, circuit ablated 0.0 of clean (accuracy 0.345), everything else ablated 1.0, status verified.
predict() implementing sign(count(ka) - count(se)) -> M/E/D agrees with the model on 400/400 held-out inputs (V0001, seed 7).

All pre-registered tests held (E0008-E0014, E0017) and V0001 passed necessity and sufficiency. Not resolved: the internal division of labour between mlp0, mlp1 and mlp2 (path patching from an MLP sender errored, so what mlp0 feeds the heads was not measured).
